notes: Anarthrous substantival adjective in construct (טֳהָר־יָדַיִם, the clause's subject) takes the ASV's supplied 'he that' under rule 46, as the chapter's other rule-46 substantives do (17.8, 17.9 s003, 17.10); only the supplied verb of having 'hath' is added, since no possessive morpheme stands in the clause (rules 20, 43). Rule 2's טוֹב־עַיִן precedent does not reach a phrase with no written pronoun and no predicate role.
